## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren** — [ish LAH-suh mish dah-FON in-shpi-REE-ren] — *I'm letting myself be inspired by it*
2. **Es fühlt sich stimmig an** — [es FÜHLT zish SHTIM-ish an] — *It feels coherent / right*
3. **Ich bin ganz bei der Sache** — [ish bin gants by dehr ZAH-khuh] — *I'm fully focused on it*
